req.title: Task title accepts unicode
req.statement: The system shall accept task titles containing UTF-8 characters and return them intact.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-031 requires that POST /tasks/ accepts UTF-8 task titles and returns them intact. Three test cases are designed: (1) EP positive — a representative multi-script Unicode title (CJK + Arabic + emoji + Latin diacritics) is posted and the response title must equal the input exactly, status 201; (2) NEG negative — a title composed entirely of null bytes / control characters that violate min_length=1 after stripping is attempted, expecting 4xx; (3) BVA boundary — a title of exactly 100 Unicode code-points (the schema max_length) is posted and accepted, while a 101-code-point title is rejected with 422. Each test is self-contained, uses the in-process FastAPI TestClient, and asserts exact values to maximise mutation kill rate.

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

def test_unicode_title_roundtrip_positive():
    client = TestClient(app)
    unicode_title = "任务标题 مهمة 🚀 café naïve résumé"
    payload = {"title": unicode_title, "description": None, "completed": False}
    r = client.post("/tasks/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert body["title"] == unicode_title
    assert body["completed"] == False
    assert body["id"] >= 21
    assert "created_at" in body

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

def test_unicode_title_boundary_100_chars_accepted():
    client = TestClient(app)
    # Use a non-ASCII character repeated to stress UTF-8 handling at boundary
    title_100 = "é" * 100
    assert len(title_100) == 100
    r100 = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": title_100, "completed": False})
    assert r100.status_code == 201
    body100 = r100.json()
    assert body100["title"] == title_100
    assert len(body100["title"]) == 100
    assert body100["id"] >= 21

    title_101 = "é" * 101
    assert len(title_101) == 101
    r101 = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": title_101, "completed": False})
    assert r101.status_code == 422

tests.executable:
import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

def test_unicode_title_mixed_scripts_intact():
    client = TestClient(app)
    title = "αβγ цикл שלום 🌍"
    r_post = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": title, "completed": False})
    assert r_post.status_code == 201
    created = r_post.json()
    assert created["title"] == title
    task_id = created["id"]
    assert task_id >= 21

    r_get = client.get(f"/tasks/{task_id}")
    assert r_get.status_code == 200
    fetched = r_get.json()
    assert fetched["title"] == title
    assert fetched["id"] == task_id
    assert fetched["completed"] == False
